title: KYRO: workflow automation SaaS
summary: Dynamic forms, workflow automation and role-based access for construction enterprises.
impact: Less manual work and faster onboarding for B2B clients.
problem: Construction enterprises needed streamlined workflows, custom dynamic forms and project automation for process management.
solution: Built workflow automation modules, dynamic form engines and role-based access on a flexible Python and MongoDB backend with reusable React components.
result: Boosted team productivity, reduced manual operational tasks and accelerated onboarding for enterprise clients.
